prompt: Some people say young people should be encouraged to leave their family when they become adults while some argue they should live for a longer time with their family. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
Family is one of the most important parts of our lives. However, there is a debate about whether to live with them for a longer period of time or to leave as they become adults. In this essay, I will describe both of the views and why I agree with the first one.

Staying with parents develops a sense of connection and love towards each other. In addition, it encourages young adults to support each other during good and bad times, which is important for people to feel safe, loved, and supported. Indeed, a person who lives with a group of people in a house understands family beliefs and values that can be helpful in their later life. As a result, it strengthens the relationship between the members and helps them live a happy life.

However, adults can choose to live independently as they grow older. By doing this, they get the chance to experience the hardships and explore the opportunities on their own. Moreover, it encourages young adults to find ways that best suit their lifestyle rather than adopting their family lifestyle. For instance, in Western culture, living apart from their parents after the age of 18 is highly prioritised, which encourages them to be independent at an early age. Therefore, if adults are encouraged to live separately from their parents, it will help them identify their own strengths and weaknesses, which can be helpful for their lives.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that if a family lives together, there is always a connection and love spread every time. However, it is also crucial to live independently, which helps young adults to understand their needs and choices.
